name: Sekisui Chemical Co., Ltd.
summary: Sekisui Chemical Co., Ltd. engages in the residential and social infrastructure creation and chemical solution business in Japan and internationally. It operates through four segments: Housing, Urban Infrastructure & Environmental Products, High Performance Plastics, and Medical.
